title: Prefix proof index
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $k$ be an index with $0\le k\le m$. The prefix proof index is the image of $k$ in the second block of the disjoint union of an $m$-element set and an $(m+1)$-element set, identified with an index from $0$ to $2m$.
